---
title: "Governance & reports"
pagetitle: "Governance"

The Centre operates under a constitution approved by the Faculty and a Research
Charter that governs research independence, data governance, and our
relationships with funders and data partners. These, and our annual reports, are
published here in full.

## Board

The Board oversees the Centre's work and holds the Director to account for it.

| Member | Position |
|---|---|
| Sophia du Plessis | Chair of the Department of Economics, Stellenbosch University |
| Dieter von Fintel | Vice-Dean: Research, Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences |
| Jesse Naidoo | Director, Centre for Household Finance |
| Hennis de Jongh | Head: Channel Sales, Capitec Bank |
| Kanshukan Rajaratnam | Director, School for Data Science and Computational Thinking |
| Tarun Ramadorai | Professor of Financial Economics, London School of Economics |
| David Fowkes | Special Advisor to the Governor, South African Reserve Bank |
